title: Openthu v0.2 encrypted storage header
description: Frozen logical header for new cross-platform authenticated-encryption files. The binary layout wraps a UTF-8 JSON header and ciphertext. Windows DPAPI files keep their existing magic and are never rewritten automatically.
x-semantics: Purpose, account domain and service domain are internal storage scopes. They are not school account types or school field names. When record_id is present, it is an opaque local record identity and is bound into the AAD; records created before this optional binding omit it for read-only compatibility.
x-record-id-binding: New SecureStore records include an opaque record_id in the header and canonical AAD. Existing v1 records without this optional field remain readable only in a legacy store pointer; copying a bound record to another record path fails with SECURE_RECORD_MISMATCH.

x-key-policy.key_location: separate owner-only key file outside the data directory
x-key-policy.missing_key: refuse production storage; never fall back to plaintext
x-key-policy.nonce: unique per key and purpose; never reused

x-purpose-values.SESSION: Authentication cookies, CSRF state and session metadata.
x-purpose-values.ACTION: Transaction plans, authorization evidence and remote reconciliation state.
x-purpose-values.MEDIA: Validated image or attachment bytes and metadata.
x-purpose-values.EVENT_CURSOR: Incremental event cursor and snapshot watermark.

x-legacy.rule: Legacy DPAPI records remain readable under their existing format. Do not import Windows credentials into a cloud checkout and do not silently rewrite legacy records into the new format.

x-unknown-values.purpose: Do not write. Unknown purpose is rejected.
x-unknown-values.key_id: Never null; missing key identity is a hard failure.

key_id.description: Opaque key identifier. Never a path, host name or account identifier.

record_id.description: Optional opaque local record identity bound into the AAD for new records. Legacy records may omit it; never a path or account identifier.

nonce.description: Base64url nonce, unique per key and purpose.

aad.description: Base64url canonical JSON bound to purpose, account, service and format version.

x-rejection-samples.why: PASSWORD is not a storage purpose
key_id must be an opaque identifier, not a filesystem path
an unauthenticated suite is not allowed
a header without nonce cannot provide authenticated encryption
